# StoatMD — full brief for AI agents

StoatMD is a Markdown notebook for making notes with an agent. Agent and human read and write the same plain folder: the agent drafts and files, the person reads, edits, and continues the work. The library is a folder of `.md` files that both a local agent and a human can reach, carried between devices by the user's own Google Drive or Dropbox.

## Positioning

The notebook is not a database and not a closed sync service. The folder is the product surface: an agent can write to it through the filesystem (local) or through the cloud folder (remote), and StoatMD adds the reading, editing, and library layer on top.

Compared with apps that require an official subscription sync: StoatMD uses the storage the user already pays for, and does not add an account or a StoatMD server.

Compared with a plain Markdown editor: StoatMD keeps the source visible, adds a separate reading surface, a file tree that agents can write to, and a conflict picker. The files remain portable.

Compared with Apple-only note apps: StoatMD is available on macOS now; Windows and Linux builds are planned later, and iPhone is planned/listed separately. Sync is not tied to iCloud.

The comparison on the website is about the sync and agent path, not a feature checklist. Product names belong to their owners.

## Business model

- Desktop app (currently macOS): free, including cloud sync. Price $0. Windows and Linux builds will use the same free desktop model.
- iPhone app: one-time purchase. The price is TBA — never invent or guess a dollar amount.
- No subscription. No account. No StoatMD server.
- Sync providers v1: Google Drive and Dropbox only. No iCloud, OneDrive, WebDAV, or self-hosted server.
- Conflict handling: keep local, keep cloud, or keep both. The “keep both” copy is `original (cloud conflict yyyy-mm-dd).md`.

## Capabilities

- Plain Markdown files, ordinary filenames, offline by default on desktop.
- Source / split / read views; the reading view gets the space.
- 25 Otty themes (9 light / 16 dark); Paper is the default. Typography settings.
- Google Drive or Dropbox library on desktop and iOS. iOS has no local-only library; the cloud folder is the source of truth and is cached offline.
- Local agents write straight into the folder. Remote agents archive through the same Drive/Dropbox folder. Teams can share one folder, with permissions staying in Drive/Dropbox.
- Eight site languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish.

## Not built

- MCP / AgentBridge, WYSIWYG editing, real-time collaboration, accounts, an own sync server.
- Windows or Linux builds are planned but not published yet.

## Release status (as of 2026-11)

- macOS: downloadable through the public GitHub Releases page of `richcalls/stoatmd-community`; the fixed installer is `releases/latest/download/StoatMD-macos.dmg`, requiring macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. (That repository hosts builds and issues; the source repository is private.)
- Windows / Linux: builds are planned; do not link to or imply an existing installer yet.
- iOS: not listed in the App Store yet.
- Do not fabricate an App Store link, release date, user count, testimonial, benchmark, or iPhone price.

## Site structure

Single long-scroll page per language, composed as quiet typographic layout: hero with the claim, an agent-note index and an interactive reading card → comparison table → four-step mechanism (agent drafts → folder → cloud → you continue) → capability list → pricing (desktop free / iPhone one-time) → download → footer. The reading card is interactive: choose one of three agent-written notes and switch between source, split, and read.

Language detection: default follows the browser (zh-TW/HK/MO/Hant → Traditional Chinese; other zh → Simplified; ja/ko/de/fr/es/en prefix match; fallback English). Manual choice is remembered in `localStorage`. Auto-redirect only on a first visit to `/` without a stored manual preference; crawlers should not be redirected away from language URLs.

## Contact / brand

Brand name: StoatMD. Domain: stoatmd.com. Do not attribute the product to unrelated personal names in marketing copy. Do not invent a working download URL beyond the public GitHub Releases page.
